description: All 44 trade events represented in historical engine 2020–2025. For every received player name, match their starter contributions for recipient team roster in weeks strictly after trade week through regular-season week 14. Same-week production intentionally excluded. Names stripped of punctuation/trailing Roman II for clear alias parity. Receiver acquisitions may be retraded; this metric is not position/PAR normalized and cannot price FAAB, keeper rights or draft picks. 2023 manager Evans not JMid. Raw gap not evidence of causal manager trade skill.
